# Smartspanner CMMS

> Cloud-based CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) software for maintenance management, asset tracking, and facilities management.

## About

Smartspanner is a simple, affordable CMMS platform designed for maintenance teams in manufacturing, facilities management, and industrial sectors. It helps teams move from spreadsheets and reactive maintenance to structured, data-driven operations.

Based in Gateshead, United Kingdom.

- Website: https://www.smartspanner.com
- App: https://app.smartspanner.com
- Support: https://support.smartspanner.com
- Contact: sales@smartspanner.com
- Phone: +44 (0) 191 300 1217

## Key Features

- Work order management (reactive and planned)
- Preventive maintenance scheduling and automation
- Asset management with hierarchy and location structure
- Multi-site deployment
- Spare parts and inventory tracking
- Mobile apps (iOS and Android)
- Reporting and dashboards
- Subcontractor management
- Checklists and inspections
- Fire risk assessments (UK-compliant, multi-site, with photo evidence and work-order actions)
- IoT condition monitoring (vibration, temperature, energy, flow meters)
- Failure codes and root cause tracking
- Purchasing and purchase orders
- API access and integrations (Power BI, ERP systems)
- Lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures

## Pricing

All prices are per user, per month. 14-day free trial included. No credit card required.

- Basic: £15/user/month — Core CMMS features, work orders, preventive maintenance, asset management, mobile apps
- Standard: £21/user/month — Adds procedures, subcontractors, failure codes, asset labels
- Advanced: £27/user/month — Adds checklists, condition monitoring, statistics, purchasing, API access

All plans include unlimited work orders, unlimited support, daily backups, and automatic updates.

## Industries Served

- Manufacturing
- Injection moulding

- Energy and utilities
- Logistics and warehousing

## Best Fit

Smartspanner is best suited to small and mid-sized maintenance teams that need a practical CMMS without a long implementation project. Common use cases include replacing maintenance spreadsheets, managing planned preventive maintenance, tracking reactive work orders, keeping asset history, coordinating contractors, monitoring spare parts, and giving technicians mobile access in the field.

## Countries and Markets

Smartspanner serves maintenance teams internationally, with dedicated information for the United Kingdom, United States, Australia, and New Zealand.

## Differentiators

- Fast implementation — up and running in under an hour
- Simple to use — designed for technicians, not just administrators
- Affordable — starting from £15/user/month
- Unlimited support — telephone and online support included at no extra cost
- Mobile-first — native iOS and Android apps for field use
- IoT-ready — optional wireless sensor monitoring with AI-powered machine health
